hooks.command: $j = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $fp = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($fp -and (Test-Path $fp -PathType Leaf) -and $fp -notlike '*.db' -and $fp -notlike '*.db-shm' -and $fp -notlike '*.db-wal') { $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-fff'; $rel = $fp -replace [regex]::Escape('c:\Users\Jackson\OneDrive\day trading iphone\'), ''; $dst = 'C:\Users\Jackson\day-trading-backups\' + $ts + '\' + $rel; try { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $dst -Parent) -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Copy-Item $fp $dst -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }
